name: Pre-rendered background
summary: Render a room or a street offline in 3D software, then show it as a fixed image behind a real-time figure or a cursor.
how: Fix the camera for each view and compose it like a film frame.
Render the background with offline light: soft shadows and many lamps.
Paint a depth mask so that the figure can pass behind props.
Match the figure's light direction to the render.

origin.note: Cyan's Myst shows its island as a set of pre-rendered still views.

adoptions.via: Resident Evil sets polygon figures over pre-rendered rooms on the PlayStation.
